analysis.insight_summary: The user struggled to stop and reprogram their [product_name] module and could not locate appropriate documentation. After being given a link to the manual, the user's issue was resolved and their main challenge—finding support documentation—was addressed. There was no mention of hardware faults, only problems accessing information.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy process for stopping their [product_name] device, modifying its program, and obtaining relevant manuals or documentation for assistance.
